\par\smallskip
{\footnotesize\raggedright Joint $\Delta$LPD: path-integrated RB estimator, mean over origins, model minus reference. Converged: share of origins at which the fit met the convergence rule (R-hat $< 1.01$, bulk ESS $> 400$ on every primary quantity). Verdict: \code{compare()} on the volatility axis, with the 95\% convergence gate on and off. In MCS: whether the model and the reference are in the model confidence set. Under the expanding window the DM test is descriptive only, so a ``better'' verdict can come only through the model confidence set (model in, reference out); each verdict's route is stated in the report's \code{reasons}. The variant comparisons exist for the full sample only.\par}
\par\smallskip
{\footnotesize\raggedright\color{accmark} Placeholder: each [ACC] cell holds a key of the acceptance report (under relative, converged, verdicts, variants); the number is never written here. The cell prints the value once \code{acceptance_values.tex} (\code{fill_acceptance.py}) defines its key.\par}
